description: This file defines a configuration class for text completion using the Codestral API, extending OpenAI's text completion configuration, and includes a method for parsing streaming chunks of data.

classes.name: CodestralTextCompletionConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Codestral text completion, extending OpenAITextCompletionConfig, with additional parameters and a chunk parser method.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the configuration with optional parameters, setting class attributes dynamically.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration dictionary from the superclass.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for this configuration.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters for API requests.

methods.name: _chunk_parser
methods.description: Parses a chunk of streaming data into a GenericStreamingChunk object, handling JSON decoding and stream completion logic.
